2026_01_BAL_IND.headline: Baltimore’s new-look defense gets an immediate test against Indianapolis’ returning quarterback
2026_01_BAL_IND.paragraph1: Baltimore opens the Jesse Minter era against an Indianapolis offense led by Daniel Jones in his first regular-season game back from an Achilles injury. The Ravens will be without Nnamdi Madubuike, which matters against a Colts offense that can lean on structure and the run game to protect its quarterback. Indianapolis, meanwhile, must account for Trey Hendrickson and Baltimore’s pressure packages without letting Lamar Jackson control possession. The matchup should hinge on protection discipline, third-down efficiency and which offense avoids creating short fields.
2026_01_BAL_IND.model_rationale: Baltimore’s pressure options and quarterback advantage can force Indianapolis to play from uncomfortable down-and-distance, but the Colts can keep it close by protecting Jones and sustaining drives.
